question_text: A 22-year-old woman comes to the urgent care clinic with sudden onset of severe vomiting. She had been at a picnic with her boyfriend a few hours earlier, enjoying barbecue, potato salad, and cake. Shortly thereafter, she began vomiting and has vomited 5 times in the last 3 hours. She has no prior history of symptoms. After a few hours of observation, her symptoms abate, and she is safely discharged home. Which of the following is the most likely cause of her vomiting?
